code.originalText: Four-week gout and blood pressure review, with urology consultation for a bladder stone

text.paragraph: Four-week gout and blood pressure review; urology consultation today. [S]

Mr. Franklin returns four weeks after starting allopurinol 100 mg and colchicine 0.6 mg daily and changing hydrochlorothiazide to losartan 50 mg. He has had no gout flare, no rash, and no diarrhea. His home blood pressure averages 136/80. He still has an interrupted stream, pain at the end of voiding, and pink urine after car journeys, and he gets up three times a night. He takes acetaminophen for the bladder pain about twice a week and no ibuprofen. He is drinking more water, about 1.5 L a day, and has cut back to one glass of wine with dinner. He saw the urologist this morning. [S]

list.item:
Gout, on treat-to-target urate lowering (M1A.0710). Serum urate 7.6 mg/dL, down from 9.1 but above the target of below 6. No flare and no allopurinol side effects. [S]
Increase allopurinol to 200 mg daily.
Continue colchicine 0.6 mg daily.
Serum urate in 2 to 5 weeks.

Bladder stone (N21.0). Urology confirms a single 2.6 cm bladder stone behind an obstructing prostate, with no bladder tumor on cystoscopy. [S]
Cystolitholapaxy with transurethral resection of the prostate booked in three weeks.
Aim for 2.5 to 3 L of fluid a day.

Benign prostatic hyperplasia with outlet obstruction (N40.1). IPSS 16, maximum flow 8.5 mL/s, and post-void residual 160 mL. A bladder stone caused by obstruction is an indication for surgery. [S]
Tamsulosin 0.4 mg at bedtime until surgery, as urology advised.

Chronic kidney disease G3a A1 (N18.31). Four weeks after starting losartan, potassium 4.4 mmol/L and creatinine 1.34 mg/dL (eGFR 55), stable. [S]
Continue losartan.
Start atorvastatin 20 mg daily, recommended for adults over 50 with eGFR below 60; report muscle aches, since he also takes colchicine.

Hypertension (I10). Office 138/80 mmHg and home average 136/80 mmHg, improving but above 130/80. [S]
Continue losartan 50 mg; recheck after surgery.
